execution.ref: claude/knn-state-digest from origin/main c690f6f70 (KNN-STATE-DIGEST-01, approved by the Test Lead)
execution.description: Added a versioned battery KNN state digest (state_sha256, carbon.battery.knn-state.v1) that binds k, train_fraction, the unit inputs and the targets, emitted by compile.rebuild beside the unchanged params_sha256, and moved the no-op audit's battery identity onto it.

expected: Fixing a fit statistic that misses a hyperparameter would mean editing recipes.py, which moves the Level-0 implementation, recipe, built-record and program pins and the run-5 baseline.
observed: A separate module outside contracts.IMPLEMENTATION_MODULES and the practice worker's staged files carried the fix with every Level-0 pin and the run-5 baseline unchanged. The audit's KNN neighbours no-op is gone. The cost is that the GPU practice worker, which does not stage the module, still reports only params_sha256.
keep: When a recorded statistic binds too little, add a new versioned field beside it and leave the old field's meaning alone.
Before editing a module, check whether its bytes feed a pinned identity (IMPLEMENTATION_MODULES, staged worker files); new logic can often live beside it instead.
Make identity readers tag the scheme they used, so old records without the new field keep their meaning and an unknown schema is refused.
change: If GPU-side KNN fits ever need the state digest, stage the module through a versioned program re-pin rather than editing recipes.py.
